entries.target: 一只身穿黑色长袍的兽人。它用刺耳的语言喃喃自语。

entries.source:
The noxious fumes have invaded all your body, you suddenty fall into a deep slumber...
... you feel you forgot something ...
... you feel lost ...
... you feel sad ...
You forgot your wife! Find her!
entries.target:
有毒的气息渗入你的全身，你突然陷入沉眠之中…
…你感觉自己忘了什么…
…你感觉自己处在迷失之中…
…你感觉自己很沮丧…
你忘了你的妻子！快找到她！

entries.source:
Surround yourself with a shield that will absorb %d%% of any fire/cold/light/arcane attack, up to a maximum of %d damage per attack.
		Every time your shield absorbs damage, you convert some of the attack into energy, gaining one point of Psi, plus an additional point for every %0.1f points of damage absorbed, up to a maximum %0.1f points each turn.
		At talent level 3, when you de-activate the shield twice the absorbed damage (if any) in the last 3 turns is released as a full psionic shield (absorbing all damage).
		The maximum amount of damage your shield can absorb and the efficiency of the psi gain scale with your mindpower.
		You can only have two of these shields active at once.
entries.target:
用护盾环绕自己，吸收 %d%% 火焰、寒冷、光系、奥术伤害，每次最多吸收 %d 伤害。
		每次你的护盾吸收伤害时，将部分攻击转化为能量，获得 1 点灵能值；每吸收 %0.1f 点伤害，还会额外获得 1 点灵能值，每回合最多获得 %0.1f 点灵能值。
		技能等级达到 3 时，关闭护盾会将此前 3 回合吸收的伤害（若有）的两倍转化为一个全效灵能护盾（吸收所有伤害）。
		护盾每次最多能吸收的伤害以及获得灵能值的效率随精神强度提高。
		你同时只能维持两个此类护盾。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You enter a zero gravity zone, beware!
I will make him pay for his treachery.
entries.target: 我会让他为自己的背叛付出代价。

entries.source: spaghettified across the whole of space and time
entries.target: 被时空之力拉成了面条

entries.source: You may not auto-explore with enemies in sight (%s to the %s%s)!
entries.target: 当有敌人在视野里时，你不能自动探索！(%s 在 %s方%s)！

entries.source: Amulets make your neck look great!
entries.target: 项链让你的脖子更加美丽！

entries.source: "You should not be here. How di-"#{normal}# It stops abruptly, and its attention seems to turn to the staff in your hands. #{italic}#"How did you get that?! You fool, you do not know what forces you play with! Get it away from here - BEGONE!"
entries.target: "你不该来这里。你怎——"#{normal}# 它的话戛然而止，注意力似乎转向你手中的法杖。#{italic}#"你是怎么得到它的？！蠢货，你根本不知道自己在玩弄怎样的力量！把它带离这里——滚！"

entries.source:
Hits the target with two shield strikes, doing %d%% and %d%% shield damage. If it hits a second time, it stuns the target for %d turns.
		The stun chance increases with your Accuracy and your Strength.
entries.target:
连续使用 2 次盾牌攻击敌人并分别造成 %d%% 和 %d%% 盾牌伤害。
		如果此技能连续命中目标 2 次则目标会被震慑 %d 回合。
		震慑几率受命中和力量加成。

entries.source: You may not auto-explore this level.
entries.target: 你不能自动探索这一层。

entries.source:
Auto-validate targets. If you fire an arrow/talent/... it will automatically use the default target without asking
#LIGHT_RED#This is dangerous. Do not enable unless you know exactly what you are doing.#WHITE#

Default target is always either one of:
 - The last creature hovered by the mouse
 - The last attacked creature
 - The closest creature
entries.target:
自动选择目标。使用技能、装备等时不再要求指定目标。
#LIGHT_RED#注意：这非常危险。除非你确切知道自己在做什么，否则不要启用。#WHITE#

默认目标会遵循以下规则选择：
 - 最后一个鼠标划过的目标。
 - 最后一个攻击的目标
 - 最近的目标

entries.source:
You absorb latent cold around you, turning into an ice elemental - a shivgoroth - for %d turns.
		While transformed, you do not need to breathe, gain access to the Ice Storm talent at level %d, gain %d%% resistance to cuts and stuns, gain %d%% cold resistance, and all cold damage heals you for %d%% of the damage done.
		The power will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你吸收周围的寒冰围绕你，将自己转变为纯粹的冰元素——西弗格罗斯，持续 %d 回合。
		转化成元素后，你不需要呼吸并获得等级 %d 的冰雪风暴，获得 %d%% 切割和震慑抵抗，%d%% 寒冰抗性，所有冰冷伤害可对你产生治疗，治疗量基于伤害值的 %d%%。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Could not generate a base object with filter: %s
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#无法使用该筛选器生成基础物品：%s

entries.source: #VIOLET#You can check the ingredients you possess by pressing Escape and selecting 'Show ingredients'.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你现在可以按 Esc 键调出游戏菜单，选择“查看材料”检查自己所拥有的材料。

entries.source: A huge being composed of sparking blue and yellow energy stands before you.  It shifts and flows as it moves, at once erratic and graceful.
entries.target: 在你面前的是一只黄蓝双色能量线的混合体。它快速的闪现和移动，看起来优雅又飘逸。
泽梅基斯，现实至高守护者

entries.source: Shield runes act instantly, letting one protect oneself quickly whilst also preparing to flee or launch a counter attack.
entries.target: 护盾符文为瞬发技能，可以在你准备逃跑或者反击的同时提供防护。

entries.source:
Infuse magic into your shadows to give them fearsome spells. Your shadows receive a bonus of %d to their Spellpower.
		Your shadows can strike adjacent foes with Lightning (level %d, %d%% chance at range 1).
		At level 3 your shadows can sear their enemies from a distance with Flames (level %d, %d%% chance at range 2 to 6).
		At level 5 when your shadows are struck down they will attempt to Reform, becoming whole again (50%% chance).
entries.target:
灌输魔力给你的阴影使它们学会可怕的法术。你的阴影获得 %d 点法术强度加成。
		你的阴影可以用闪电术攻击附近的目标（等级 %d，%d%% 几率 1 码范围）。
		等级 3 时你的阴影可以远距离使用火焰术灼烧你的敌人（等级 %d，%d%% 几率 2 到 6 码范围）。
		等级 5 时你的阴影在被击倒时有一定几率重组并重新加入战斗（50%% 几率）。

entries.source: %s brandishes %s, calling forth the might of the oceans!
Your Shoot talent now costs %d stamina but fires %d times for %d%% damage per shot.
entries.target: 你的基础射击技能消耗 %d 体力，发射 %d 石弹，每颗造成 %d%% 伤害。

entries.source: An elven mage, dressed in crackling blue robes, and smelling of ozone.
entries.target: 一位精灵法师，穿着噼里啪啦的蓝色长袍，身上散发着臭氧的味道。

entries.source:
The final three important #GOLD#combat stats#WHITE# of your character are these:

#LIGHT_GREEN#Physical power: #WHITE#Your ability to inflict damage and effects with weapons (including fists).
#LIGHT_GREEN#Spellpower: #WHITE#Your ability to inflict damage and effects with spells.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Mindpower: #WHITE#Your ability to inflict damage and effects with your mind.
entries.target:
角色的最后三个重要 #GOLD#战斗属性#WHITE#：

#LIGHT_GREEN#物理强度：#WHITE#你的武器造成伤害或效果的能力（包括徒手攻击）。
#LIGHT_GREEN#法术强度：#WHITE#你的法术造成伤害或效果的能力。
#LIGHT_GREEN#精神强度：#WHITE#你的精神造成伤害或效果的能力。

entries.source:
Teleports you to up to %d tiles away, to a targeted location in line of sight.
		At talent level 5 you may swap positions with a target creature.
entries.target:
将你传送至视线内的指定位置，最远距离为 %d 格。
		技能达到 5 级时，你可以与目标生物交换位置。

entries.source: #CADET_BLUE#You cannot disarm traps in grids you cannot enter.
entries.target: #CADET_BLUE#你不能解除你无法到达的陷阱。

entries.source: Zemekkys points to the location of Vor Armoury on your map.
entries.target: 泽梅基斯在你的地图上指出了沃尔军械库的位置。

entries.source: Abilities of the various objects of the world.
entries.target: 世界上各种物品的技能。

entries.source: Here's a list of the monster bits I need. I've already got a bunch of idiots out looking for these, by the way, so you best hurry up; they've got a head start on you and I'm not getting any saner here.
entries.target: 这是我需要的怪物部位清单。顺便说一句，我已经派了一帮蠢货在外面搜寻这些东西了，所以你最好快点；他们可比你先行一步，而我呆在这儿可不会变得越来越清醒。

entries.source:
A powerful tool against my enemies. Yes, yes. They all hate me, but I will show them my power!
I will show them! SHOW THEM!
entries.target:
一个对抗敌人的强力工具，对，没错，他们都仇恨我，我要让他们尝尝我的厉害！
给他们点颜色看看！等着瞧！

entries.source: The target's morale is weakened, reducing its attack power, mind power, and spellpower by %d.
entries.target: 目标士气低落，物理、法术和精神强度减少 %d。

entries.source: A trade ledger of the Iron Throne dwarves.
entries.target: 钢铁王座矮人贸易账本。

entries.source: You decided you cannot let slavers continue their dirty work and destroyed them!
entries.target: 你认定不能任由奴隶贩子继续干这种肮脏勾当，于是消灭了他们！

entries.source:
Concentrate on maintaining a Crystalline Focus, increasing all your physical damage by %0.1f%% and ignoring %d%% physical resistance of your targets.
		Also raises your physical and magical saves by %d.
entries.target:
你专注于维持水晶力场，增加你 %0.1f%% 所有物理伤害并忽略目标 %d%% 的物理伤害抗性。
		同时增加你 %d 点物理和魔法豁免。

entries.source: You found notes from an explorer inside the Old Forest. He spoke about Sher'Tul ruins sunken below the surface of the lake of Nur, at the forest's center.
entries.target: 在古老森林里找到了一个探险者的笔记，里面提到在森林中心的纳尔湖底下有一个沉没的夏·图尔遗迹。

entries.source: Thank you, @playername@. I hate to admit it, but you saved my life.
entries.target: 谢谢你，@playername@。不得不承认，你救了我的命。
